title: Split Testing
seo: Ad split testing and A/B test setup
meta: Simple, fair tests of ads, offers and landing pages with a clear winner and next steps. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Split testing for ads, offers and pages
overview: We help you learn what works instead of arguing about it. We pick one thing to test, such as a headline, an offer or a landing page, build two or more versions, and set the test up in your ad account so budget and audience are split evenly. When enough results are in, we write up the winner, how sure we are, and what to test next. Tests are small and honest.

pkgs.blurb: One clear test set up with a plan for reading the result.
Two tests, including an offer test, with a results write-up.
A testing program that includes a landing page test.

faq: How much traffic do I need to test?
Enough for each version to get a few dozen results, or at least a few hundred clicks. If your budget is too small for that, we choose a bigger change to test, so a clear answer is still possible.
Can you test two different landing pages?
Yes on Premium. We use a simple traffic split, with your page tool or the ad platform's experiments, and we need edit access to build the second page or you supply it.
That is a result too. It tells you the change did not matter much, so you can stop worrying about it. We then suggest a bolder variation or move on to a more important question.
Does testing slow my campaigns down?
A little, because platforms spend part of the budget on each version. We keep tests short and small so most of your money still works, and we stop weak versions as soon as the data allows.
